cohort: Mothers who delivered babies weighing ≥4.0 kg at Bahrain Defence Force Hospital from 2001 to 2011
finding: There was a trend towards offering more elective Cesarean sections in patients with macrosomic babies in the presence of pre-existing diabetes.
mod_finding: The majority of patients with pre-existing diabetes who were offered a trial of labor achieved vaginal delivery with minimal morbidity.
